chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from 'Amr ibn Abi al-Miqdam, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام.
He described tayammum: he struck the ground with his two hands, then raised them and shook them off, then wiped his forehead and his two palms once.

key_terms.التَّيَمُّمَ: dry ablution performed with earth or dust in place of wudu (ablution) or ghusl
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the ground or earth used as the medium for tayammum
key_terms.جَبِينِهِ: his forehead, the part wiped during tayammum
key_terms.كَفَّيْهِ: his two palms, which are wiped in tayammum
key_terms.مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً: one single time, indicating the number of wipes or action described

ai.seo_question: How is tayammum performed according to the hadith of Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the method of tayammum as taught by Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام. It indicates a single striking of the earth followed by wiping the forehead and the palms once, which is relevant to rulings on ritual purity and acts of worship.
